prompt: Can you design learning course equal to MBA in finance?
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 most directly fulfills the prompt by proposing a structured “equivalent to an MBA in finance” curriculum with an explicit 2-year/semester breakdown, electives, and a capstone. Candidate 3 is also highly relevant and thorough, but it frames the output more as a self-study plan (with resources) than a formal course blueprint comparable to an MBA program. Candidate 2 provides a reasonable set of required components, but it lacks the same level of course structure, sequencing, and program-level design. Candidate 4 largely reframes the request by listing alternative degrees/credentials rather than designing an MBA-equivalent finance learning course.
